semantic_fragments.content: Clause 8.3.1 specifies that transit-operable, handheld, and body-worn ME equipment shall maintain basic safety and essential performance after undergoing the test of IEC 60529 for at least IP 22, while all other ME equipment shall meet at least IP21. For portable ME equipment intended to be used only while in a carrying case, IP21 shall be met with the equipment inside the carrying case. The tested product achieved IP22 and was confirmed to provide basic safety and essential performance.

Clause 8.1 requires that a lay operator in the home healthcare environment can perform cleaning or cleaning and disinfection processes. The usability of each such process pertaining to a lay operator was investigated by the usability engineering process. Evidence references: Usability test report and usability engineering file.

The product is not classified as Class I permanently installed ME equipment; therefore, clauses 7.5.1 requirements for technical description including protective earth connection warnings and earthing specifications are all N/A.
The product does not require professional hygienic maintenance prior to re-use; therefore, clauses 7.4.7 (professional maintenance) and 7.5.2 are both N/A.
The product does not involve sterilization; therefore, clause 8.2 (lay operator performing cleaning and sterilization) is N/A.
